reason: The user requested read access from chat. Add an explicitly enabled, per-message, read-only capability with a bounded workspace file reader and visible source receipts; preserve the existing no-write/no-command boundary.
required_invalidations: Confirm the default request denies file access and the UI requires per-message opt-in.
Verify traversal, absolute paths, symlink escapes, sensitive/runtime paths, binary/oversized files, and credential-like content are denied.
Verify only bounded text ranges inside the bound project are returned and source paths/line ranges are visible.
Verify both app-assistant and agent chat flows use Ollama tool calling only when opted in; no write or command tool is offered.
Build/static verification and report whether a live Ollama tool-call was run.
decision: Accepted under the current user request; proposed the per-message read-only boundary, then amended the frozen control-plane contract before implementation verification.
